newsitem.title: ITALY: TABLE - ITALIAN JUNE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT ROSE 0.4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - ITALIAN JUNE INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT ROSE 0.4 PCT.

text.p: National Statistics Institute ISTAT gave the following provisional figures for industrial production, year-on-year, in June.
Note: (The industrial production index was rebased in January 1994 on 1990 levels, replacing a 1985-based index.)
-- Istat said average daily output, non seasonally adjusted but workday adjusted, rose 1.3 percent year-on-year in June.
-- Production of consumer goods, on an unadjusted basis, rose 4.8 percent year-on-year in June. Investment goods rose 2.4 percent and intermediate goods rose 6.8 percent.

-- On an adjusted basis, production of leather goods rose 0.9 percent year-on-year, textile and clothing rose 6.8 percent, non-metal minerals rose 3.5 percent, metals rose 5.2 percent, machinery rose 5.8 percent and transport rose 16.2 percent. Paper products rose 15.1 percent and refineries and carbon coke rose 19.4 percent. -- Rome newsroom +39 6 678 2505
